intuition: Each trailing zero needs a factor pair 2 times 5, and factorials contain more factors of 2 than 5.

brute_force.approach: Factor every integer from one through n and count each factor of five.

optimal.approach: Repeatedly divide n by five and sum the quotients to count factors contributed by powers of five.

edge_cases: Values below five have no trailing zeros.
Multiples of 25 contribute an additional factor of five.
Zero factorial has zero trailing zeros.
